title: Extract the state paths the app reads
notes: Code: checks/parity-paths.py:198-202 (--write writes docs/STATE-PATHS.json), :205-208 (FAIL lines then the total `N paths, N unknown or unserved, N untyped`, exit 1 on any), selftest end :303 `N problems`; scripts/gates.sh:24-25 (the gate line; its own failure echo `GATE RED: parity-paths`); scripts/main-job.sh exists (line 30 is the install step); checks/job-order-check.py:48-54 prints `PASS <name>` per check and `N checks, N failed, 0 not judged`, selftest :94 `N problems`. Three dry-run crashes = par-macshell, par-sidebar and par-inboxlist `--dry` (docs/lanes/tests-r58.md:84, :94, :115-125); the fix is in journeys/lib/harness.py (class Dry, line 16). Proofs 5-7 prove that a dry run ends in its total line instead of a Traceback; they run no app (the harness `force_dry` path, harness.py:308-317). The mutant 1 changes the one SidebarData.swift read of smart_folder/<id>/count to a path no row covers (the finding of the lane: _captures/tests-r58/parity-paths-real-mutant.log did the same with reply/sources); it is red only if the generated row for that read is keyed by the pattern `smart_folder/<folder>/count` (docs/STATE-PATHS.json:667 area), which is why `smart_folderz` appears in no row. Mutant 2's red is the absence of any line (the grep prints nothing: `fail: ^$` marks an empty output). No mutant is given for the three dry crashes: a one-line break of class Dry that makes a dry run crash again was not found by reading; the baseline crash itself is the red (lane note line 84). The job-order check is not in scripts/gates.sh (grep of gates.sh for job-order finds nothing); the item does not require it.
